role: Deterministic synthetic camera frame generation for perception pipeline unit tests
detail: Provides SyntheticFrameSource (async context manager) and SyntheticObject (frozen dataclass) for test-safe frame synthesis without hardware. _render_frame() generates raw RGB bytes in row-major format (width*height*3 bytes total). SyntheticFrameSource accepts configurable width (default 640), height (default 480), background_color ((0,0,0) default), objects list, session_id, and max_frames limit. Each get_frame() call renders objects as rectangles atop background, coordinates clamped to bounds, with frame_sequence auto-incrementing. Objects overwrite in paint order. Returns Frame with timestamp (UTC now), session_id, frame_id=f"synthetic-{sequence}", width, height, and raw RGB data bytes.
gotchas: None identified; code is clean, deterministic, and well-tested. All edge cases (clamping, overflow, empty objects) handled explicitly.
